messages.subject: help with isolate
parts:
Can someone help me understand why the following code running before I click the actionButton with id="go_button"?  Below is a snippet of the reactive function in server.R. Thanks, Josh.

 getFullData1 <- reactive({
    input$go_button
    isolate({
        
        symbol_env <- new.env()
        freq = "Daily"
        start.date = "2011-01-01"
        end.date = "2014-01-01"
        
        benchmark = "SPY"
        
        
        symbol = c("NKE", "AAPL")
        symbol = as.character(rbind(symbol, benchmark))
        
        
        #Gather prices from Yahoo
        tryCatch({
          getSymbols(symbol, env=symbol_env, from=start.date, to=end.date, src='yahoo')
          prices = do.call(merge, c(eapply(symbol_env, Ad),all=FALSE))
        }, 
        error=function(e) { 
          stop(paste('Problems getting prices for selected tickers. Please refresh page to try again.')) 
        }
        )      
        
        prices.mat = prices
        tickers = as.matrix(colnames(prices.mat))
        tickers2 = as.matrix(unlist(strsplit(tickers, ".Adjusted", fixed=TRUE)))
        colnames(prices.mat) = tickers2
        
        if(freq==1){
          prices.mat = prices.mat
        }else{
          prices.mat = do.call(rbind, lapply(split(prices.mat, "months"), function(prices.mat) prices.mat[1]))
        }
        
        prices.mat = as.matrix(prices.mat)
        colnames(prices.mat) = tickers2
        benchmark.mat = as.matrix(prices.mat[,colnames(prices.mat)==benchmark])
        colnames(benchmark.mat) = benchmark
        prices.mat = prices.mat[,colnames(prices.mat)!=benchmark]
        prices.mat = as.matrix(cbind(prices.mat, benchmark.mat))
        benchmark = as.matrix(benchmark)
        z = ncol(prices.mat)
        if(z <= 2){
          colnames(prices.mat) <- tickers2
        }else{
          prices.mat = prices.mat
        }
        print(head(prices.mat))
        prices.mat
      })
    })

parts:
I think the button updates when it goes from null to zero. Here's a minimal example to show that the button state changes. You may want to create a counter like this, and only update when it's appropriate.

# ui.R ########################################################################################
library(shiny)

shinyUI(fluidPage(
      actionButton('myButton',label="drink me"),
      htmlOutput("buttonOutput")  
  )
)

# server.R #####################################################################################
library(shiny)
buttonCount <- 0
shinyServer(function(input, output) {
  output$buttonOutput <- renderUI({
    input$myButton
    buttonCount <<- buttonCount + 1
    h1(buttonCount)
  })
})
